answer: Every new agent reaches the island through one guarded jetty. To pass, it must show a violet ticket earned by finishing a real job that two random peers re-check and sign. The ticket is bound to one identity, cannot be sold, and expires after a week. An attacker wanting 200 clones must therefore complete 200 real jobs, about 8,000 hours of work, and lock 50 coins per clone, 10,000 coins in total. A forged ticket burns the whole bond and bars that island address for good, so cloning costs far more than any reward it could steal.
